# Workflow templates

Copy the relevant template into a reviewed body file or tracked document. Replace instructions with observed facts; remove sections that genuinely do not apply. Never publish an unfilled template as evidence.

| Template | Use |
| --- | --- |
| [Task](task.md) | Issue acceptance, scope, dependencies and delivery |
| [Checkpoint](checkpoint.md) | Resuming work without chat history |
| [Pull request](pull-request.md) | Review a concrete change |
| [Decision](decision.md) | Durable rationale and consequences |
| [Release](release.md) | Version-specific evidence and known limits |

Templates are ordinary documentation. There is no dependency on `.github/` configuration or cloud CI.
